# LearnHouse Documentation

> LearnHouse is an open-source learning platform: a block editor for courses, AI tutoring, assignments, payments and communities, on LearnHouse Cloud or self-hosted with one command. Developers can build on it with the REST API, the @learnhouse/sdk TypeScript client, and the @learnhouse/react and @learnhouse/vue components.

Every page below is plain Markdown at its URL. The complete text of all pages is at https://docs.learnhouse.app/llms-full.txt.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started.md): Learn what LearnHouse is, how these docs are organized, and the fastest way to start your academy on LearnHouse Cloud or on your own servers.
- [Cloud vs Self Hosting](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started/cloud-vs-self-hosting.md): Compare LearnHouse Cloud with self-hosting on updates, backups, SSL, scaling, data access and support to choose how to run your academy.
- [Key Concepts](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started/key-concepts.md): Learn the core LearnHouse concepts: organizations, courses, chapters, activities, the Library, learning paths, trails and the block editor.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.learnhouse.app/getting-started/quickstart.md): Start a LearnHouse academy on LearnHouse Cloud or your own server, then create your first course, brand it, and invite your first learners.
- [Guides](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides.md): Follow end-to-end guides for building on LearnHouse: a headless learning platform with Next.js, scripted content through the API, and webhooks.
- [Build a Learning Platform](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform.md): Build a headless learning platform with Next.js and the LearnHouse API: a public course catalogue first, then sign-in, enrollment and progress.
- [Agent Spec](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform/agent-spec.md): Copy a self-contained spec that lets a coding agent build a headless LearnHouse platform with Next.js, with the real API contract and acceptance criteria.
- [Build It Yourself](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform/do-it-yourself.md): Build a headless learning platform step by step with Next.js and the LearnHouse API, from a public catalogue to sign-in, enrollment and progress.
- [Let an Agent Build It](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/build-learning-platform/with-an-agent.md): Have a coding agent like Claude Code or Cursor build your headless LearnHouse learning platform for you from a ready-made, self-contained spec.
- [Custom Features with the API](https://docs.learnhouse.app/guides/custom-features.md): Drive LearnHouse from your own scripts with an API token: create courses and chapters, search content and find every endpoint in the API Reference.

## Platform

- [Enterprise Edition](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise.md): Learn what the LearnHouse Enterprise Edition adds, which Cloud plans include each feature, and how to activate a license on a self-hosted instance.
- [Audit Logs](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/audit-logs.md): Review who changed what in your LearnHouse organization with audit logs: what is recorded, how payloads are redacted, filters, CSV export and the API.
- [CRM Integrations](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/crm.md): Connect LearnHouse to HubSpot or Salesforce: sync members as contacts, push learning activity, map companies and orders, and invite people from CRM lists.
- [Demo Instances](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/demo-instances.md): Run a full LearnHouse deployment for one prospect: passwordless sign-in links, the Demo API for branding and content, and a report of what they tried.
- [Live Sessions](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/live-sessions.md): Schedule LearnHouse live sessions in LearnHouse Meet, Google Meet, Zoom or any link, with chat, Q&A, polls, attendance, recordings and self-hosted setup.
- [LTI 1.3](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/lti.md): Add LearnHouse courses and content to Moodle, Canvas, Open edX and other LMSs with LTI 1.3, including deep linking, grade sync and class lists.
- [LMS setup guides](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/lti/lms-setup.md): Connect LearnHouse to Moodle, Canvas, Open edX, Sakai, ILIAS, Chamilo or OpenOLAT over LTI 1.3 with step-by-step setup for each LMS.
- [SCORM](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/scorm.md): Import SCORM 1.2 and 2004 packages into LearnHouse courses, check package size limits, and see how completion, scores and results are tracked.
- [Single Sign-On (SSO)](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/sso.md): Set up single sign-on for your LearnHouse organization: pick a provider, limit email domains, auto-provision accounts and set the callback URL.
- [Custom OIDC](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/sso/custom-oidc.md): Connect LearnHouse SSO directly to any OpenID Connect provider such as Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, Keycloak or Auth0 with a client ID and secret.
- [WorkOS](https://docs.learnhouse.app/enterprise/sso/workos.md): Connect LearnHouse SSO through WorkOS for SAML or OIDC: set the instance credentials, then let your IT team finish setup in the WorkOS portal.
- [Platform Overview](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform.md): Find your way around LearnHouse features for learners, teachers and admins, from courses and assignments to communities and payments.
- [AI](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/ai.md): Turn on LearnHouse AI for your organization, index courses for Copilot and see how many AI credits each plan includes and what each AI action costs.
- [Connect AI Apps (MCP)](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/ai/connect-ai-apps.md): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP apps to LearnHouse so they can build courses, edit pages and report on learners for you.
- [AI for Students](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/ai/for-students.md): See how learners use Ask AI on an activity and Copilot or custom agents in Messages to get answers, summaries and flashcards from your LearnHouse courses.
- [AI for Teachers](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/ai/for-teachers.md): Use LearnHouse AI tools to build courses: the AI Course Creator, AI Editor, Magic Blocks, quiz and task generation, images, narrated audio and captions.
- [Analytics](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/analytics.md): Learn how LearnHouse analytics collects and stores learner activity, who can see it, and how to set retention and privacy for your organization.
- [Course Analytics](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/analytics/course-analytics.md): See how learners find, enroll in, move through and finish one LearnHouse course with the course analytics tab, its widgets and its exports.
- [Analytics Dashboard](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/analytics/dashboard.md): Read the LearnHouse analytics dashboard, from live users and enrollment funnels to feature adoption and advanced retention widgets, and export the data.
- [Assignments](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/assignments.md): Create assignments in a LearnHouse course, set grading, retries, deadlines and copy-paste blocking, and see what learners get when they hand in work.
- [Assignment Analytics](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/assignments/analytics.md): Read an assignment's Analytics tab: class average, median, pass rate, on-time rate, grade distribution, task performance and learners who need support.
- [Formative Assessment](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/assignments/formative.md): Run a formative assignment that is handed in but never graded, and unlock a model answer for learners when they submit or after their work is marked.
- [Grading & Submissions](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/assignments/grading.md): Learn how assignment grades are calculated, choose a grading type, use automatic grading, review submissions, give feedback and finalize learner grades.
- [Task Types](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/assignments/task-types.md): Add quiz, file submission, form, code, short answer and number answer tasks to an assignment, set their grading options and generate tasks with AI.
- [Automations](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/automations.md): Push LearnHouse events to your own systems with webhooks or Zapier, and choose the right option for CRMs, Slack alerts and other automations.
- [Event Catalogue](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/automations/events.md): Browse every LearnHouse webhook event, from course completions and sign-ups to payments and community posts, with the data payload each one sends.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/automations/webhooks.md): Send signed LearnHouse webhook events to your own server, verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures, handle retries and manage endpoints from the dashboard or API.
- [Zapier](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/automations/zapier.md): Build a Zapier integration on the LearnHouse REST Hook endpoints: API token auth, trigger catalogue, dropdown sources and event subscriptions.
- [Boards](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/boards.md): Use boards, shared real-time canvases for live classes and group work: add members and roles, notes, frames, AI playgrounds and timers, and work live.
- [Calendar](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/calendar.md): Use the personal LearnHouse calendar to see assignment deadlines, chapter releases, course starts, podcast episodes and live sessions by month or agenda.
- [Certifications](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/certifications.md): Award certificates for completing a course or learning path, design them with the certificate designer, and verify or revoke them on their public pages.
- [Code Execution](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/code-execution.md): Set up Code Playground challenges that run learner code in 30 languages with test cases, hints, locked lines and solutions, plus the execution limits.
- [Courses](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses.md): Create a course in LearnHouse from scratch, with AI or from existing files, then manage, clone, export and open its settings from the dashboard.
- [AI Course Creator](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/ai-course-creator.md): Use the AI Course Creator to plan a course in a chat, attach source material, create the chapters and generate every activity, and see its AI credit cost.
- [Chapters and Activities](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/chapters-and-activities.md): Organize a course into chapters and activities, pick an activity type, publish or unpublish content and lock chapters to signed-in users or user groups.
- [Drip Content](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/drip-content.md): Release course chapters over time with drip content: schedule by enrollment or cohort date, add completion conditions, email learners and preview the plan.
- [Import & Export](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/import-export.md): Export, clone and import LearnHouse courses, bring in courses from Moodle, Canvas and other LMSs, or build a course from a folder of videos and documents.
- [Library](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/library.md): Organize courses, podcasts, communities, boards, playgrounds and media into Library folders, control who sees them and reuse media in course pages.
- [Course Settings](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/settings.md): Configure a course's general info, access, contributors, SEO and certification tabs, and post course updates that learners can follow by RSS.
- [Taking a Course](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/taking-a-course.md): See what learners get when they take a course: the course page, activity navigation, focus mode, Ask AI, the video player and the end of the course.
- [Trails](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/trails.md): Learn how a learner's Trail records course progress and completions, what the Progress page shows, and what happens when a learner quits a course.
- [AI Video Captions](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/courses/video-captions.md): Generate AI closed captions for uploaded videos, translate them into up to 15 languages, create video chapters and see how many AI credits captions use.
- [Communities](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/discussions.md): Create communities in LearnHouse where members start discussions, reply, upvote and react, and link a community to a course to show its threads there.
- [Discussions & Replies](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/discussions/comments.md): Start a discussion in a community, pick a label, reply, upvote and react, and use moderator actions to pin, lock or delete discussions and replies.
- [Managing Communities](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/discussions/managing.md): Manage a community's settings: name, thumbnail, access, linked course and moderation rules such as blocked words, length limits, slow mode and auto-lock.
- [Editor](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/editor.md): Write Dynamic Page lessons in the LearnHouse block editor: use the slash menu and toolbar, keep version history, resolve edit conflicts and edit with AI.
- [Blocks](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/editor/blocks.md): Browse every block in the LearnHouse editor, from text and media to quizzes, flipcards, code challenges, embeds and tables, with the options each one has.
- [Dynamic Content and Templates](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/editor/dynamic-content.md): Personalize lessons with variables, conditional blocks and community tags, preview a page as any learner, and save blocks or pages as reusable templates.
- [H5P Interactive Content](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/editor/h5p.md): Embed H5P interactive content in a course page from H5P.com, Lumi, Moodle, Drupal or WordPress, size the frame and fix blank or cut-off H5P embeds.
- [Messages](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/messages.md): Chat in LearnHouse Messages with direct messages, group chats and course announcements, build AI agents that answer from your courses and set reminders.
- [Organizations](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations.md): Understand what a LearnHouse organization holds, where to manage its settings, users and developer tools, and how the getting started checklist works.
- [Admin Dashboard](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/admin-dashboard.md): Use the LearnHouse admin dashboard at /admin to manage every organization and user on your instance, toggle features and create superadmin API tokens.
- [Custom Domains](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/custom-domains.md): Serve your LearnHouse organization from your own domain: add it, create the TXT and CNAME DNS records, verify it and check that HTTPS is active.
- [Landing Page](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/landing-page.md): Build a custom LearnHouse home page from sections like hero, courses, pricing and FAQ, start from a template, and control who sees each section and when.
- [Multi-Tenancy](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/multi-tenancy.md): Run several organizations on one LearnHouse instance: which editions allow it, how to turn on multi-organization mode and how data stays isolated.
- [Plans & Limits](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/plans.md): Compare LearnHouse Cloud plans, their member, course and AI credit limits, and which features each plan unlocks, plus what self-hosted editions include.
- [SEO](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/seo.md): Set SEO defaults for your LearnHouse organization: sitemap and robots.txt, title suffix, meta description, Open Graph image and Google Search Console.
- [Organization Settings](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/organizations/settings.md): Configure your LearnHouse organization settings, from name, branding and public menu to optional features, AI, analytics retention and the danger zone.
- [Learning Paths](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/paths.md): Build a learning path from your courses with required and elective courses, guided order and a path certificate, then follow learners' progress through it.
- [Payments](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/payments.md): Sell courses, communities, podcasts, boards and playgrounds in LearnHouse with Stripe Checkout, your own checkout, free claims or invite-only access.
- [Sell with Any Tool](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/payments/api.md): Sell LearnHouse content through Gumroad, Paddle, Shopify or invoices, then grant, revoke or check buyer access from Zapier, Make or your backend.
- [Promotion Codes](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/payments/discounts.md): Create Stripe promotion codes in LearnHouse payments, set percent or amount discounts, usage limits and expiry, and turn codes on for specific products.
- [Customers & Access](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/payments/enrollments.md): Manage who has access to your paid LearnHouse products: customer statuses, granting access by email or user group, revoking access and exporting customers.
- [Payment Groups (Legacy)](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/payments/groups.md): Understand legacy LearnHouse payment groups, what happened to existing groups when products started holding content directly, and how to change them now.
- [Products & Pricing](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/payments/offers.md): Create LearnHouse payment products: pick the content they unlock, sell single chapters or lessons, set one-time or subscription prices and a checkout.
- [Playgrounds](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/playgrounds.md): Create AI-generated playgrounds, interactive pages built from your description or a course, then set their access, publish them and embed them in lessons.
- [Podcasts](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/podcasts.md): Publish a podcast in LearnHouse: upload and order episodes, let learners listen in the site player, submit the RSS feed and use episodes in lessons.
- [Search](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/search.md): Search courses, lessons, folders, communities, discussions, playgrounds, podcasts and members across your organization, with visibility rules and limits.
- [Command Palette and Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/search/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Use the LearnHouse command palette and keyboard shortcuts to search, jump between pages with g chords and move through courses and lessons without a mouse.
- [Users and Access](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users.md): Manage people in your LearnHouse organization: the Users dashboard tabs, which plan each needs, and member and admin seat limits on LearnHouse Cloud.
- [Authentication](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/authentication.md): Choose which sign-in methods your LearnHouse organization allows, and learn about email verification, password resets, session lifetimes and login limits.
- [Emails](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/emails.md): See every email LearnHouse sends for accounts, invitations, drip chapters, unread messages and live sessions, how it is branded and how to unsubscribe.
- [Learner Analytics](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/learner-analytics.md): Open one learner's analytics record in LearnHouse to review their courses, assignments, sign-ins and certificates, then compare or export records.
- [Members & Invites](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/members-and-invites.md): Manage LearnHouse members: search and export the Users list, set open or closed signup, create invite codes, add signup fields and invite people by email.
- [Roles and Permissions](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/roles-and-permissions.md): Learn what the Admin, Maintainer, Instructor and User roles can do in LearnHouse, and create custom roles with their own permissions on the Pro plan.
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/two-factor.md): Turn on two-factor authentication for your LearnHouse account with an authenticator app, save backup codes and require 2FA across your organization.
- [User Groups](https://docs.learnhouse.app/platform/users/user-groups.md): Create LearnHouse user groups to give a set of members access to courses, communities, folders, boards and podcasts in one step, and see how members join.

## Self-hosting

- [CLI](https://docs.learnhouse.app/cli.md): Install and use the LearnHouse CLI to deploy, update, back up and manage a self-hosted instance, or run a local development stack.
- [Commands](https://docs.learnhouse.app/cli/commands.md): Reference for every LearnHouse CLI command, including setup, start, update, backup, restore, doctor, env, scale and dev, with flags and exit codes.
- [Dev Mode](https://docs.learnhouse.app/cli/dev-mode.md): Run LearnHouse locally with npx learnhouse dev. PostgreSQL and Redis run in Docker, and the API, web and collab servers run with hot reload.
- [CLI Environment Variables](https://docs.learnhouse.app/cli/environment-variables.md): Environment variables the LearnHouse CLI reads, such as LEARNHOUSE_DIR and LEARNHOUSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD, and how its generated .env file is laid out.
- [Setup Wizard](https://docs.learnhouse.app/cli/setup-wizard.md): Walk through the LearnHouse setup wizard step by step, from edition, domain and HTTPS to database, Redis, organization, admin and features.
- [Self-Hosting LearnHouse](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting.md): Self-host LearnHouse on your own server with the LearnHouse CLI. Install it with one command, then configure, update, back up and monitor it.
- [Configuration Overview](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/configuration.md): Configure a self-hosted LearnHouse instance with environment variables, edit the generated .env file and apply changes with the LearnHouse CLI.
- [AI Setup](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/configuration/ai-setup.md): Turn on AI features in self-hosted LearnHouse with Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Ollama or another provider, and set models and RAG embeddings.
- [Email Configuration](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/configuration/email.md): Set up email for a self-hosted LearnHouse instance with Resend or any SMTP server, and set the sender address and display name for outgoing mail.
- [Environment Variables](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/configuration/environment-variables.md): Reference for every environment variable a self-hosted LearnHouse instance reads, with types, defaults and the service that uses each one.
- [SSL and Domain Setup](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/configuration/ssl.md): Set up a domain and SSL for self-hosted LearnHouse with automatic Let's Encrypt certificates or your own reverse proxy, and set the cookie domain.
- [Content Storage](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/configuration/storage.md): Choose where a self-hosted LearnHouse instance stores uploaded content, either a local Docker volume or S3-compatible storage such as AWS S3, R2 or MinIO.
- [Installation Overview](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/installation.md): Install a self-hosted LearnHouse instance with the LearnHouse CLI, which generates and runs the Docker Compose stack, backups and updates for you.
- [Quick Install](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/installation/quick-install.md): Install LearnHouse on your own server in a few minutes. Run the setup wizard with npx or a one-line installer, start the stack and log in.
- [System Requirements](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/installation/requirements.md): Check the system requirements for self-hosting LearnHouse, including Docker with Compose v2, Node.js 22+, at least 2 GB of RAM and free ports.
- [Maintenance Overview](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/maintenance.md): Keep a self-hosted LearnHouse instance healthy with the CLI. Update it, back up and restore data, monitor services and fix common problems.
- [Backups](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/maintenance/backups.md): Back up and restore a self-hosted LearnHouse instance with the CLI, covering the database, .env file and uploaded content, plus cron automation.
- [Monitoring](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/maintenance/monitoring.md): Monitor a self-hosted LearnHouse instance with CLI health checks, the /api/v1/health endpoint, logs, Sentry error tracking and resource limits.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/maintenance/troubleshooting.md): Fix common problems on a self-hosted LearnHouse instance, such as services not starting, database errors, port conflicts and sign-in issues.
- [Updates](https://docs.learnhouse.app/self-hosting/maintenance/updates.md): Update a self-hosted LearnHouse instance with npx learnhouse update, learn how database migrations run, and roll back to an earlier version.

## Developers

- [LearnHouse Headless](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers.md): Build your own learning platform on LearnHouse: embed lessons, render them in React or Vue, or drive everything from the SDK and REST API.
- [REST API](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api.md): Find your way around the LearnHouse REST API: base URLs, where the full endpoint reference lives, and the guides for tokens and headless grading.
- [API Tokens and Sessions](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api/authentication.md): Create and manage LearnHouse API tokens, choose their permissions, and sign in with user sessions, refresh cookies and two-factor codes.
- [Headless Assignments](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/api/headless-assignments.md): Run LearnHouse assignments from your own frontend with an API token: create tasks with custom data, submit answers for learners and grade them.
- [Architecture Overview](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture.md): See how LearnHouse fits together: the Next.js web app, FastAPI backend, collaboration server, CLI, PostgreSQL, Redis and the single app image.
- [Backend Architecture](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture/backend.md): Learn how the LearnHouse FastAPI backend is built: Python 3.14, SQLModel, Alembic, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis, background jobs and CLI tasks.
- [Frontend Architecture](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture/frontend.md): Learn how the LearnHouse Next.js 16 frontend is built: React 19, the App Router, Tiptap editor, runtime config and how it talks to the API.
- [Supporting Services](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/architecture/services.md): Configure the services LearnHouse runs alongside its apps: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis, the Hocuspocus collaboration server and the reverse proxy.
- [Contributing to LearnHouse](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/contributing.md): Start contributing to LearnHouse: set up the dev environment, read the guidelines, and find good first issues or propose a feature on GitHub.
- [Development Environment Setup](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/contributing/dev-environment.md): Set up a local LearnHouse development environment with one CLI command that starts PostgreSQL, Redis, the API, the web app and the collab server.
- [Contribution Guidelines](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/contributing/guidelines.md): Follow the LearnHouse contribution workflow: branch naming, lockfiles, pull requests against dev, code style and the CI checks to run locally.
- [Embed LearnHouse Activities](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/embed.md): Put a LearnHouse activity on any website with an iframe: fit it to its content, set colours and language, and react when learners finish.
- [Migrating Content into LearnHouse](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration.md): Choose how to bring existing courses into LearnHouse: import another LMS export, script every call through the API, or let AI propose the structure.
- [Activity Types Reference](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/activity-types.md): Look up the content JSON each LearnHouse activity type expects, from Tiptap dynamic pages and media uploads to assignments, custom and SCORM.
- [AI-Assisted Migration](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/assisted.md): Upload a folder of videos, PDFs, images and audio, let LearnHouse AI propose chapters and activities, then create the whole course in one API call.
- [Import from Another LMS](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/from-another-lms.md): Import a Moodle, Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, Open edX or Common Cartridge export into LearnHouse from the dashboard, the CLI or the API.
- [Programmatic Migration](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/migration/programmatic.md): Script a full course migration through the LearnHouse API: create the course, chapters and every activity type, upload media, reorder and publish.
- [LearnHouse React Component](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react.md): Render LearnHouse activities inside any React app with @learnhouse/react — the same blocks and styles as LearnHouse, themed to match your product.
- [Customize the React Component](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/customization.md): Theme LearnHouseActivity, replace or wrap any block, hide blocks, rewrite content, and add your own header and footer.
- [React Component Events](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/events.md): Listen to what learners do in a LearnHouseActivity — loading, links, media playback, size changes, visibility and completion.
- [React Component in Next.js & Vite](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/frameworks.md): Use LearnHouseActivity in the Next.js App Router (including server rendering and fetching on the server) and in Vite apps.
- [How the React Component Works](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/how-it-works.md): How @learnhouse/react renders activities without an editor, and how it is built from LearnHouse's own source at every release.
- [Signed-in Learners](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/learners.md): Let embedded LearnHouse activities act as one of your learners. Mint a short-lived embed session on your server and pass it to the provider, so progress, code runs and assignments are saved for them.
- [Localize the React Component](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/localization.md): Show LearnHouseActivity's interface in 22 languages, override any string, and render right-to-left.
- [React Component Props Reference](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/react/reference.md): Every prop of LearnHouseActivity and LearnHouseProvider, and everything @learnhouse/react exports.
- [LearnHouse JavaScript SDK](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk.md): @learnhouse/sdk: a typed JavaScript and TypeScript client for the LearnHouse API with no dependencies, for browsers, Node, Bun, Deno and React Native.
- [SDK Authentication](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/authentication.md): Authenticate @learnhouse/sdk with an org API token on servers, or as a signed-in learner in browsers and apps.
- [LearnHouse SDK for React Native](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/react-native.md): Use @learnhouse/sdk in React Native and Expo apps — sign learners in, keep their tokens in secure storage, and refresh them.
- [SDK Typed Requests & Errors](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/requests.md): Call any LearnHouse API endpoint with full types, handle errors, and control timeouts, retries, rate limits, pagination, cancellation and hooks in @learnhouse/sdk.
- [SDK Resources](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/resources.md): The @learnhouse/sdk resources (organizations, courses, chapters, activities, search, progress, users, auth and media URLs) and the endpoint each method calls.
- [SDK Webhooks](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/sdk/webhooks.md): Verify LearnHouse webhook signatures with @learnhouse/sdk, turn deliveries into typed events, and skip duplicate or replayed deliveries.
- [Versions & Releases](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/versioning.md): How @learnhouse/sdk, @learnhouse/react and @learnhouse/vue are versioned with LearnHouse releases, and which version to install for your instance.
- [LearnHouse Vue Component](https://docs.learnhouse.app/developers/vue.md): Render LearnHouse activities in Vue 3 and Nuxt with @learnhouse/vue, using the same renderer and blocks as LearnHouse and @learnhouse/react.

- [Operations JSON](https://docs.learnhouse.app/reference/operations.json): machine-readable list of every operation
